env_interact: build a Python module to interact with an AutoResetEnvBase environment using a custom interactor and yield EnvInteractData steps
env_interact_random_actor: run a random actor against an AutoResetEnvBase environment for a specified number of steps
env_interact_with_model: run a world model agent against an AutoResetEnvBase environment and yield interaction data steps
Interactor: create a custom interactor class by subclassing Interactor and implementing init_state and act_and_update_state methods
BasicEnvState: build a BasicEnvState NamedTuple to track episode count, step count, observations, rewards, and done flags
